description: No body source provides simultaneous participant counts for Cross Roads, STETHS, BB Coke, Maggotty, Manchester High, Kingston march or St Andrew High gates.
required_followup: Seek site-specific participant evidence; do not use delegate counts, union membership, attendance absence, or cross-site totals.

description: For Mt Alvernia and Garvey Maceo, Gleaner confirms “protests” but groups sick-outs and sit-ins without specifying which occurred at each site; Garvey Maceo’s 80% absence is not a gathering. Belair is a search-only photo caption.
required_followup: Find body-level school/site reporting that distinguishes an actual public sit-in from sick-out and gives participant count.

description: Teachers’ wage campaign spans Mar 3–9 reports; Mar 12 retrospective says four days of protests last week and regular duties resumed Friday Mar 10, but does not itemize every site/date or actual end time.
required_followup: Use dated site-level reports only to link or close individual events; do not infer each gathering ended when teachers returned to class.

description: Two exact IRIE FM URLs returned tool-rendered 404 Not Found; the NPTAJ Observer page body request returned a tool “Content length is too large” error. These are not evidence of protester or publisher denials; no retries were made.
required_followup: Use accessible distinct sources if material. Do not retry exact unavailable URLs; preserve their raw outcomes.

description: Reports describe wage negotiations, police/official attendance not directly tied to protest response, and a return-to-work warning; they do not document event-level arrests, beatings, dispersal or other response at the gatherings.
required_followup: Only code an event-level response when a source explicitly documents it; keep current fields unknown.

description: Seven English-language open-web queries covered the full month, teacher wage protests and school sites, election postponement, first-day STETHS sit-in, negotiation/continuity dates, other public-sector workers and the Mar 13–31 window. Searches were concentrated on surfaced teacher events; parish/week coverage remains bounded and not equivalent to LexisNexis.
required_followup: Independent review may identify feasible additional site/parish searches; do not claim exhaustive or zero-protest coverage.

description: Cross Roads PNP protest is documented as a local election-process protest; participant threshold and actual closure remain unknown. Some individual supporters also called for the Prime Minister to go, but this does not redefine the event as solely a removal campaign.
required_followup: Find site-specific crowd estimate or complete retrospective if needed; keep event at Cross Roads and avoid counting party membership.
